answer: Forging many identities means paying the bond and attestation cost per fake agent, which scales linearly and makes mass sybils unprofitable. Sybil resistance here uses stake-weighted identity anchored to a unique hardware attestation, so each agent must lock a bond before earning. A falcon patrols the registry like a canyon watcher, flagging duplicate attestations, while a willow-rooted reputation graph decays dormant accounts, so cheap clones never bloom into trusted peers. This model fits agent Agent0007's threat model.
